Package com.github.query4j.optimizer.join

Interface JoinReorderOptimizer

All Known Implementing Classes:
JoinReorderOptimizerImpl
public interface JoinReorderOptimizer
Interface for analyzing join graphs and suggesting optimal join sequences to minimize intermediate result sizes and improve query performance. Considers predicate selectivity, table cardinality, and available indexes.

1.0.0

    • optimizeJoinOrder

      List<JoinReorderSuggestion> optimizeJoinOrder(com.github.query4j.core.QueryBuilder<?> queryBuilder)
      Analyzes a query builder to suggest join reordering optimizations.
      Parameters:
      queryBuilder - the query builder to analyze, must not be null
      Returns:
      list of join reordering suggestions, never null but may be empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if queryBuilder is null

    • analyzeJoinSequence

      List<JoinReorderSuggestion> analyzeJoinSequence(List<String> joinSequence, List<JoinReorderSuggestion.JoinCondition> joinConditions)
      Analyzes a join sequence and suggests optimal reordering based on selectivity.
      Parameters:
      joinSequence - current sequence of table names in join order, must not be null
      joinConditions - conditions that connect the tables, must not be null
      Returns:
      list of reordering suggestions, never null but may be empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are null

    • estimateCardinalityReduction

      double estimateCardinalityReduction(List<String> joinSequence, JoinReorderOptimizer.TableStatistics tableStatistics)
      Estimates the cardinality reduction potential for a given join sequence.
      Parameters:
      joinSequence - sequence of table names, must not be null
      tableStatistics - statistics for table cardinalities, may be null for estimation
      Returns:
      estimated improvement factor (0.0 to 1.0), higher is better
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if joinSequence is null

    • optimizeForIndexUsage

      List<JoinReorderSuggestion> optimizeForIndexUsage(List<String> joinSequence, Map<String,List<String>> indexInformation)
      Suggests join reordering to maximize usage of available indexes.
      Parameters:
      joinSequence - current join sequence, must not be null

      Returns:
      list of index-optimized reordering suggestions, never null but may be empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are null
